Art_11_docs.pipeline: Gödel → p-adic → NTT → KAG → Penrose P3

godel_encoding.description: Maps binary data to a prime-exponent vector. Position i → prime p_i; exponent = byte value at position i. Preserves ordering via block-position weighting.

padic_lift.description: Extends Gödel exponent vectors into the p-adic metric space. Encodes residue classes (mod p^k) to measure arithmetic closeness of weight blocks.

ntt_fingerprint.description: Number-theoretic transform over GF(998244353). Produces a 1024-length spectral fingerprint from p-adic residues. Resistant to byte reordering; sensitive to structural changes.

kag_grid.description: Kolmogorov-Arnold Geometry: 8×8 additive grid on NTT magnitude vector. Measures separability via row/column mean decomposition. NOT a Jacobian-based KAN; additive approximation only.

penrose_p3.description: Maps KAG hash to a deterministic Penrose P3 tiling patch. Penrose match score measures how well the chunk's spectral signature conforms to quasicrystalline structure — an indicator of weight regularity.
penrose_p3.tiling: Penrose P3 (kite / dart via pentagrid intersection)

bf16_bias_heuristic.description: Scans raw bytes for systematic BF16 sign/exponent patterns. High penalty → likely weight quantisation artefact or distribution skew.

assumptions: Input file is a valid ML model weight file (safetensors, GGUF, or raw binary).
Chunk size is fixed at 1 MB; partial final chunks are processed as-is.
The Genesis Frame (physical constants c, ħ, G) is the immutable coordinate origin.
known_limitations: Does not detect semantic bias in model outputs — weights only.
BF16 bias heuristic is probabilistic; false positives possible on highly compressed files.
Penrose match score is a structural proxy, not a direct measure of model correctness.
Trojan / backdoor detection is partial; dedicated tools recommended for high-risk deployments.

Art_13_transparency.method_summary: This report was generated by deterministic mathematical analysis using spectral transforms (NTT over GF 998244353) and manifold descriptors (Penrose P3 quasicrystalline tiling). All results are fully reproducible from the input file.

Art_13_transparency.ai_involvement_disclosure: This audit was performed entirely by deterministic algorithms. No generative AI was used in the scoring or reporting pipeline.
